以下是计算每个类目毛利额的 SQL 查询：

```sql
SELECT c.name, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.qty) AS total_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.
